description.value: Spice Hut is a family-run Indian restaurant in Port Alberni, founded by two brothers whose culinary training spans 5-star hotels in Mumbai including the Taj Mahal Hotel. The kitchen specializes in North Indian and Mughlai cuisine made from scratch using traditional spice blends, with a menu ranging from tandoori dishes and biryanis to vegan-friendly paneer and vegetable options. Dine-in, takeout, and local delivery are all available, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the Alberni Valley.

address.value: 5328 Argyle St, Port Alberni, BC V9Y 1T8, Canada

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 13m; rack at 40m.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active sit-down restaurant with takeout and vegan/GF options in Port Alberni — a natural stop on Vancouver Island touring routes. Sufficient evidence to list as a Food & Drink entry.
